changelog: Clarifies source-aware random scheduling: each series is shuffled independently, sources remain in their configured order, and the 'some at a time' setting always takes exactly that many episodes from each source before moving on. The content-page preview now refreshes when any scheduling option changes, including same-source probability.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
